entities.name: Joseph B. Foraker
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joseph Benson Foraker was an American politician of the Republican Party who served as the 37th governor of Ohio from 1886 to 1890 and as a United States senator from Ohio from 1897 until 1909.
